name: InsideDM — start a published flow from a business event

nodes.name: Configure event
nodes.notes: Keep eventId stable across retries and reruns. Configure property mappings in the native flow builder. This starts a flow; it cannot resume an arbitrary paused run.

nodes.name: Discover workspace
nodes.notes: Select a Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <business-key>. Use the same credential on every HTTP node.

nodes.name: Retain business event

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { id: $('Configure event').first().json.eventId, binding: $('Configure event').first().json.flowId, subject: { contactId: $('Configure event').first().json.contactId }, properties: $('Configure event').first().json.properties } }}

nodes.notes: Requires events.write. HTTP 202 retains the start. Later flow admission, effects and delivery remain separate.

nodes.name: Read operation once
nodes.notes: Requires operations.read. Observe the authorized run separately with flows.read; flow completion alone does not prove delivery.
